SSC Stenographer Final Result 2025-26 Out: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the SSC Stenographer Grade C and D Final Result on 25th August 2026. A total of 1715 candidates have been provisionally selected for appointment, including 232 candidates for Grade ‘C’ and 1,483 candidates for Grade ‘D’. SSC has released the result in PDF format on its official website, ssc.gov.in. Candidates can download the merit list PDF and check their roll numbers to know their selection status. In this article, get the SSC Stenographer result 2026 PDF link, steps to download result, minimum qualifying marks and more.

SSC Stenographer Final Result 2025-26 PDF

SSC has released the final result PDF for the Stenographer Grade ‘C’ and ‘D’ Examination, 2025. The PDF contains the list of candidates in roll number order who have been provisionally shortlisted for Document Verification and subsequent appointment. Candidates can download the PDF and search for their roll number using the Ctrl+F option. SSC has also released a separate PDF showing candidates who qualified in the CBE for the Shorthand Skill Test.

SSC Stenographer Final Result 2025-26 Out

A total of 1,715 candidates have been provisionally selected for appointment in the final result of SSC Stenographer exam. Out of these, 232 candidates are for Grade ‘C’ and 1,483 candidates are for Grade ‘D’. The allocation has been made on the basis of merit-cum-preference and the options selected by candidates during the Sliding/Identity Verification process.

SSC Stenographer Final Result 2025-26: Overview

The SSC Stenographer Final Result has been declared on ssc.gov.in. The result PDF shows the names and roll numbers of candidates provisionally selected for appointment. Candidates can check the important details of the result below.

SSC Stenographer Final Result 2025-26: How to Check?

Candidates can follow the steps below to check their SSC Stenographer 2025-26 result:

  1. Open official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Go to Results section.
  3. Find the Stenographer Grade ‘C’ & ‘D’ Examination, 2025 result.
  4. Click on final result PDF link.
  5. Download PDF.
  6. Open and press Ctrl+F.
  7. Enter your roll number.
  8. Check your selection status.

SSC Stenographer Grade ‘C’ Final Result 2025

SSC has recommended 232 candidates for Stenographer Grade ‘C’. The selected candidates will be assigned to different ministries, departments and cadres according to their merit, preference and applicable rules. The category wise details are given below.

SSC Stenographer Final Selection 2025-26

The final allocation was completed after the First Round of Tentative Allocation (FRTA) and the Sliding/Identity Verification (IV) process. The physical Sliding process was conducted at the SSC Regional Offices on 11th and 12th August. Candidates who did not attend the process were treated as absent and were not considered for the final allocation. The allocation details are:

Option Candidates
FIX 1,055
FLOAT 549
New Allocation 111
Total 1,715

SSC Stenographer Final Result: Department Allocation

After the SSC Steno final result 2025-26, selected candidates will be allocated to different government departments and ministries. The allocation is based on the candidate’s merit, post preference and the option selected during the sliding process. The final department allotted to each candidate is given in the official result PDF.

  • The Grade ‘C’ allocation includes departments such as the Central Administrative Tribunal, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of External Affairs, Ministry of Home Affairs, Election Commission of India, Ministry of Defence, Central Vigilance Commission, Ministry of Labour & Employment, Ministry of Jal Shakti and Ministry of Culture.
  • Grade ‘D’ candidates have also been allocated to various departments, including the Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Defence, Ministry of Home Affairs, Ministry of Railways, Ministry of External Affairs, Ministry of Labour & Employment and other government organisations.

What After SSC Stenographer Final Result 2025-26?

Candidates who have been selected for appointment will now have to complete the Document Verification (DV) and other appointment formalities. Candidates will be required to submit the necessary educational, category and other documents. The final appointment will be done once verification of eligibility and documents is over. SSC has made it clear that the final selection is provisional. The Commission will not handle the DV and appointment process after candidates are allocated to their respective departments.

SSC Stenographer Cut Off 2025-26

SSC has also released the result of the Grade ‘C’ Stenographers Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2025. The Computer Based Examination was held on 4th July. Out of 371 candidates who appeared, 370 candidates qualified for the Stenography Skill Test. The SSC Stenographer cut off marks is given in the table below.

SSC Stenographer Final Answer Key and Marks

Staff Selection Commission has checked the objections raised by candidates against the tentative answer key and made the required changes. The final answer key was then used to calculate the marks. SSC will soon upload the individual marks of both qualified and non-qualified candidates on its official website.

SSC Stenographer Final Result 2025-26: FAQs

Question: When was the SSC Stenographer Final Result 2025 released?

Answer: The SSC Stenographer Grade ‘C’ and ‘D’ Final Result 2025 was released on 25 August 2026.

Question: How many candidates are selected in SSC Stenographer Final Result?

Answer: A total of 1,715 candidates have been conditionally selected for recruitment to posts. These include 232 Grade ‘C’ and 1,483 Grade ‘D’ candidates.

Question: From where can I download the SSC Stenographer Final Result PDF?

Answer: Candidates can download the steno final result PDF from the direct link given in this article.

Question: What is the next step after SSC Stenographer Final Result?

Answer: Selected candidates will be subject to document verification and other formalities for appointment through User Departments.

Question: Are marks of all the candidates released by SSC?

Answer: No. SSC has announced that individual marks of qualified and non-qualified candidates will be uploaded on its website.
